user.title: Set up a Smarther thermostat
user.description: The MQTT bridge is a one-time prerequisite. [First-time setup guide](https://github.com/alescim17/smarther/blob/main/docs/FIRST_TIME_SETUP.md). Enter only the name and device topic prefix; never paste vendor credentials here. Setup does not send thermostat commands.

data_description.topic_prefix: Use the topic prefix ending just before /device_state.

error.mqtt_not_ready: Configure MQTT in Home Assistant first.

init.title: Control policy
init.description: Only enable after verifying remote bridge routing, fresh telemetry and absence of competing command writers.
